- Serum Calcium (mg/dL)

- Report corrected calcium to two decimal places.  
- No rounding of intermediate values; apply full precision before final rounding.

MELD(i) = 0.957 × ln(Cr) + 0.378 × ln(bilirubin) + 1.120 × ln(INR) + 0.643

If round(MELD(i), 1) × 10 > 11, then:
MELD = MELD(i) + 1.32 × (137 − Na) − [0.033 × MELD(i) × (137 − Na)]

Final MELD Na score = min(MELD, 40)

Conventions:
- Cr: if <1.0, use 1.0; if ≥4.0, use 4.0
- bilirubin: no floor/ceiling mentioned, so use reported value
- INR: no floor/ceiling
- Na: if <125, use 125; if >137, use 137

- Bilirubin: 1.5 mg/dL → use as is
- INR: 2.2 → use as is
- Sodium (Na): 143 mEq/L → since >137, set to 137 mEq/L

Step 3: Compute MELD(i)

First, compute natural logs:

- ln(Cr) = ln(1.2) ≈ 0.18232
- ln(bilirubin) = ln(1.5) ≈ 0.40547
- ln(INR) = ln(2.2) ≈ 0.78846

Now compute:

Break it down:

- 0.957 × 0.18232 ≈ 0.17446
- 0.378 × 0.40547 ≈ 0.15326
- 1.120 × 0.78846 ≈ 0.88208
- + 0.643

Sum:  
0.17446 + 0.15326 = 0.32772

So, MELD(i) ≈ 1.8528

Since 19 > 11, apply the correction formula.

MELD = 1.8528 + 1.32 × 0 − [0.033 × 1.8528 × 0]  
MELD = 1.8528 + 0 − 0 = 1.8528

Step 6: Cap at 40 → min(1.8528, 40) = 1.8528

Final MELD Na score = 1.8528
